units: <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 4:6">Ab. d’R. N. ch. IV</cite>, end (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="D00950"><he>דעת</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>נְעִימוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a">Ib.</cite> <he>שינה הקב״ה נ׳ בני אדם זה מזה</he> the Lord made the dispositions of men different one from the other.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:18">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>יודע נ׳ יתירה היה</he> he knew an extraordinary way of singing; <cite ref="Yoma 38b:2">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> <he>כשהוא נותן קולו בנ׳</he> when he tuned his voice to a trill.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 71a:12">Kidd. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>הבליע שם בנְעִימַת וכ׳</he> he let the Divine Name (the Tetragrammaton which he pronounced) be drowned in the chant of his brother priests; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11">Num. R. s. 11</cite>, end <he>אמרו בתוך נעימת וכ׳</he> he pronounced it during the chant &c. Y. Shek. V, 55ᶜ bot. <he>סורח את הנ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A00451"><he>אִדְרַבְלִיס</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Megillah 32a:12">Meg. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>הקורא בלא נ׳</he> he who recites Bible verses without chanting; <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 3:10">Treat. Sof’rim III, 10</cite>. Cant. R. to VIII, 14 <he>בנ׳ אחת</he> in one accord; a. fr.
